tests: Choosing the storage class that minimizes cost for an unknown, changing access pattern without lifecycle rules.
expected: S3 Intelligent-Tiering — automatic movement between tiers for a small monitoring fee, no retrieval fees. Triggers: "unpredictable/changing access patterns", "no lifecycle configuration", "no retrieval fees".
why_not: Standard does not optimize cold data; Standard-IA with lifecycle assumes a known pattern, adds retrieval fees and a minimum storage duration; Glacier Deep Archive retrieval takes hours.
